record.name: Paraguay
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. Paraguay has a draft national AI roadmap built on UNESCO's readiness assessment, and a risk-based AI bill has been in the Senate since 2025.

related_bodies.name: MITIC
related_bodies.role: It leads national AI policy and the UNESCO readiness assessment; no model evaluation mandate was found.

record.notes: The government news agency report (primary, 26 June 2026) says MITIC leads AI work and that the roadmap starts with governance and the regulatory framework; it names no evaluation body. The Senate bill (secondary, May 2025) requires a preliminary assessment by the provider to classify each system's risk and sets out a procedure for algorithmic impact assessment; the report names no enforcement authority or institute. A later search summary dated the bill's filing to July 2026, which conflicts with the 2025 article date; this was not resolved.
